title: AkcliLibraryBaseline
description: The library baseline `akcli library audit --write-baseline` writes (default `akcli-library.baseline.json` beside the .kicad_pro) and `library audit --baseline` / `release preflight --library-baseline` compare against: a committed, hashed record of every PROJECT sym-lib-table / fp-lib-table entry. Deterministic and machine-independent: sorted keys and lists, `\n` newlines, no timestamps, no tool version, no absolute paths. Hashes are SHA-256 over raw bytes. src/akcli/library_baseline.py is the executable copy of this contract; tests/test_library_baseline.py asserts the two agree.

schema_version.description: A minor bump only adds optional fields; a reader accepts any 1.x and refuses another major.

symbol_libraries.description: One record per project sym-lib-table entry, sorted by nickname.

footprint_libraries.description: One record per project fp-lib-table entry, sorted by nickname.

global_libraries.description: Library nicknames the project's schematics use that the PROJECT tables do not register — reached, if at all, through the per-user global table. Recorded by nickname only: their paths and bytes belong to the KiCad install, not to the project.

uri.description: The table entry's uri exactly as written (variables unexpanded).

path.description: Where the uri resolved, relative to the project directory (posix). null when it lies outside the project, or when status is `unresolved` or `builtin`.

status.description: `ok`: resolved, exists, files hashed. `missing`: resolved to a path that does not exist. `unresolved`: the uri uses a ${VAR} that does not expand. `builtin`: the uri goes through a KiCad built-in ${KICAD<N>_*_DIR} variable — KiCad's own stock library, recorded by reference only and never hashed.

files.description: File name (relative to the library) -> SHA-256. A symbol library: its .kicad_sym. A footprint library: every .kicad_mod of the .pretty, plus `provenance.json` when one sits in it (a single-file library of another plugin type: that file). Empty unless status is `ok`.

models.description: Footprint libraries only: every 3D model the library's footprints reference, sorted by (file, ref). Never silently dropped: a model that cannot be hashed stays listed with its status.

file.description: The .kicad_mod (a key of `files`) that references the model.

ref.description: The model path exactly as the footprint writes it.

path.description: The resolved model file relative to the project directory (posix); null when outside the project or not resolved.

status.description: `hashed`: resolved and exists. `missing`: resolved, file absent. `unresolved`: uses a ${VAR} that does not expand. `builtin`: referenced through a KiCad built-in ${KICAD<N>_3DMODEL_DIR}-style variable — a stock model, recorded by reference only.
